ops.title: Design revision 2026-07-14: local-first delivery, no hosted relay
ops.body:
The cc-runtime remote-delivery design dropped the hosted 'online bus' relay. The server is the dev machine's own daemon; clients reach it via loopback, LAN, or the user's tailnet.

Locked decisions (user-approved):
- Bind: 'cc-runtime pair' -> 0.0.0.0 + bearer token (cc-present parity; loopback bypasses token); 'pair --off' -> loopback-only; 'pair --reset-token' revokes all devices.
- Pairing: cc-present pattern (QR/manual/Bonjour), payload extended to {v, name, urls[], token} carrying LAN IP + MagicDNS URLs; clients probe urls in order (loopback -> LAN -> ts.net).
- TLS: tailscale cert HTTPS for the ts.net leg (iOS ATS blocks plain http to *.ts.net); plain HTTP on LAN under NSAllowsLocalNetworking. NEVER tailscale serve: its proxied requests arrive from loopback and ride cc-interact's loopback token bypass (auth hole).
- Push: direct outbound from the daemon - APNs (token-based .p8, HTTP/2) + Web Push (VAPID). No relay, no inbound ports.
- Multi-machine: client-side machine roster AND a synckit-style daemon mesh (Registry{Self,Hosts} flock state.json, DetectSelf via 'tailscale status --json', host add over SSH with reverse registration, cross-machine ops as SSH-invoked peer CLI, presence-routed delivery per cookie-sync consent.go).
- Donors: cc-present (pairing kit, iOS Keychain/roster/SSE client), synckit/cookie-sync (identity/discovery/SSH mesh patterns - PolyForm NC, copy patterns, never import).
